title: Squishymania by Ella
about: A catalogue of real NeeDoh toys by Schylling. Empty fields mean we could not verify that fact. The secret Star Glob is not a real product.

items.name: The Original NeeDoh
items.rarityWhy: It is still in the 2024 and 2026 catalogues and on Schylling.com.
items.texture: Soft dough that slowly fills back in
items.feature: Always puffs back into a ball
items.description: The Groovy Glob that started the whole squish. Squeeze it, pull it, smush it, and it comes back round.
items.note: Year 2017 is from Schylling's NeeDoh page ('the original since 2017') and the Adventure Town guide. The 'since 1975' line on that page is Schylling the company, not this toy.
items.imageNote: Product photo cropped from a Schylling NeeDoh catalogue. The 2026 book is the file used when the toy is in both.

items.name: Super NeeDoh
items.rarityWhy: A bigger Groovy Glob. Schylling sells it, and it costs more than the classic, so shops carry fewer.
items.feature: About twice as big as the classic Groovy Glob
items.description: The Groovy Glob, all grown up. One big squeeze instead of a little one.
items.note: Release year is not printed. Schylling's page says it is twice a Classic and lists 4.5 inches. The 2024 catalogue lists item code SYSPND at 114.3 mm.
items.imageNote: Product photo cropped from the Schylling 2024 NeeDoh catalogue PDF.

items.name: Swirl NeeDoh
items.rarityWhy: A regular Groovy Glob colorway in the 2024 catalogue, called a bestseller there.
items.feature: The colors swirl together
items.colors: Assorted swirls, including pink, blue, and orange
items.description: A Groovy Glob with colors swirled together, like a marble you can squish.
items.note: Schylling.com search lists Rainboh nearby, and the 2024 catalogue lists SWIRL NEEDOH, item code SYSWND. Exact swirl color list is from Stormberry, not the catalogue.
items.imageNote: Product photo cropped from the Schylling 2024 NeeDoh catalogue PDF.

items.name: Glow in the Dark NeeDoh

items.feature: Glows in the dark
items.description: A Groovy Glob that glows after the lights go out. Charge it in the light, then take it somewhere dark.
items.note: 2024 catalogue lists SYGND and assorted SYAGND. 2026 catalogue lists the assortment SYAGND. Color list is from Stormberry.
items.imageNote: Product photo cropped from a Schylling NeeDoh catalogue. The 2026 book is the file used when the toy is in both.
